description_en: Queries the daily peak number of concurrent stream ingest operations
description_zh: 查询用户的每日上行并发推流数峰值
kebab_example: aliyun vs describe-vs-up-peak-publish-stream-data --start-time 2017-12-10T20:00:00Z --end-time 2017-12-10T21:00:00Z --domain-switch on --domain-name example.com --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeVsUpPeakPublishStreamData

parameters.help_en: Start time of stream ingest, in UTC format. The time range between StartTime and EndTime must be within 30 days
parameters.help_zh: 拉流开始时间，UTC格式, StartTime和EndTime时间间隔在30天内
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: End time of stream ingest, in UTC format. The time range between StartTime and EndTime must be within 30 days. EndTime must be later than the current time
parameters.help_zh: 拉流结束时间，UTC格式, StartTime和EndTime时间间隔在30天内,且EndTime超过当前时间
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: Enables or disables domain-level statistics. Valid values: on or off. When set to on, the response shows domain-level data. When set to off or omitted, the response shows user-level data. Default is user-level data
parameters.help_zh: 域名统计开关，取值：on或者off；on：开启域名统计级别，off：用户级别数据。默认统计用户级别数据
parameters.name: domain_switch

parameters.help_en: Domain name to query. Returns data at the domain granularity
parameters.help_zh: 输入域名，查域名粒度数据
parameters.name: domain_name

DescribeVsUpPeakPublishStreamData.description_en: Daily peak concurrent stream ingest data
DescribeVsUpPeakPublishStreamData.description_zh: 每日峰值并发推流数据

PeakTime.description_en: The peak time for daily concurrent stream ingests
PeakTime.description_zh: 每日峰值并发推流数的峰值时刻

PublishStreamNum.description_en: Daily peak number of concurrent stream ingest operations

QueryTime.description_en: The query timestamp for the day

StatName.description_en: Name of the statistical property. When DomainSwitch is on, this field shows the live streaming domain name. When DomainSwitch is off or omitted, this field shows the user ID
StatName.description_zh: 统计数据属性名称。当DomainSwitch取值为on时，显示用户直播域名；为off或者不传值是显示用户Id
